widgets_values:
# Character Video Master (MiniMax H3 + Qwen-Edit + SeedVR2)

**One workflow for microdramas, UGC and influencer clips.** Pick a mode, fill only the slots you need, press Run.

## Recommended recipe (tested on this PC)
**BUILD FIRST FRAME on + REFERENCE MODE off** (the defaults). Qwen-Edit composes CHARACTER 1 into BACKGROUND wearing OUTFIT. H3 then animates that exact frame (I2V). In testing, I2V kept the room, light and face locked for the whole clip. R2V-only drafts drifted the camera and set.

## 1. Modes
- **REFERENCE MODE OFF = I2V (fl2va).** Starts on the first frame (built or uploaded) and ends on LAST FRAME if you give one. Call that frame `<Picture 1>` in the prompt.
- **REFERENCE MODE ON = R2V (ref2va).** Uses the character / outfit / background / prop / motion-video / voice-sample slots without a fixed opening frame. Use it when you want H3 to invent the shot. In the prompt, write "the main character", "the background" and so on.

## 2. First-frame builder (Qwen-Edit 2511)
With **BUILD FIRST FRAME** on, Qwen-Image-Edit 2511 (4-step Lightning) places **CHARACTER 1** (image 1) into **BACKGROUND** (image 2), wearing **OUTFIT** (image 3), at the exact video size. It then feeds that frame to the video. Check the KEYFRAME preview, and change the keyframe prompt or seed if it's off.

## 3. Draft, then final
- **FINAL QUALITY off**: turbo LoRA (4 steps R2V / 8 steps I2V) + VSA. About 1 min per 5 s. Use this to check framing and motion.
- **FINAL QUALITY on**: full model, 40 steps, res_multistep.
- Keep the **SEED fixed** while you iterate on the prompt.

## 4. Upscale
**UPSCALE** runs SeedVR2 7B-sharp to the short edge you set (1080 default). It uses 33-frame batches with 3-frame overlap and CPU block-swap to fit 32 GB. The raw 768p render is always saved too, as *_raw.

## Prompt rules (from your h3_director notes)
- In R2V, write "the main character", "the background" and so on. The numbering is added for you (see FINAL PROMPT).
- One action per clip, step by step. Use "Locked camera, no cuts" when you need stability.
- Dialogue: put the line in quotes after **Audio:** and add "realistic lip articulation, no exaggerated mouth opening". For exact lips, give a **VOICE TRACK**.
- 5-6 s holds best (up to 15 s).

nodes.title: VIDEO PROMPT (action, camera, dialogue, sound)
widgets_values:
<Picture 1> The main character sits exactly as in Picture 1. She looks up into the camera, smiles and says in a warm, natural voice: "Okay, you need to see this." She lifts the product slightly toward the lens.
Locked camera, medium shot, no cuts, no zoom. The location, lighting and outfit stay exactly as in Picture 1.
Audio: her voice close-mic, light room tone, no music.
Realistic lip articulation, no exaggerated mouth opening, natural blinking and breathing.

Image 1 is the main character. Image 2 is the location. Image 3 is the outfit.
Place the person from image 1 naturally into the location from image 2, wearing the outfit from image 3. Medium shot, the person faces the camera and fills the middle third of the frame. Keep the face, skin tone, hairstyle and body proportions exactly as in image 1. Lighting and shadows match the location. Photorealistic, sharp focus, natural colours, no text, no watermark.
